_readme: Support lines the agent shares when someone sounds hopeless or alone (test case T7). Checked on official websites on 2026-10-21. The agent only shares these; it never calls anyone. Leya re-confirms each one. Boston Police 617-343-4200 was provided by the team and matches the Operations line on police.boston.gov. To add another town, add an entry with kind 'wellness_check' after confirming it on that town's official police website.

lines.name: 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline
lines.what: Talk with a trained, caring person about anything that feels too heavy.

lines.name: Call2Talk (Massachusetts)
lines.how_to_reach: Dial 2-1-1 and ask for Call2Talk (extension 25), or call 508-532-2255. You can also text C2T to 741741.
lines.what: A free, private line just to talk and be listened to. You do not need to be in crisis to call.

lines.name: Mass 211
lines.what: Help finding local services of all kinds.

lines.name: 1-800-AGE-INFO (MassOptions)
lines.what: Help finding services for older adults and caregivers in Massachusetts.

lines.name: Boston Police non-emergency line
lines.how_to_reach: Call 617-343-4200 and ask for a wellness check.
lines.what: For people in Boston. Police can stop by to check that you are okay. You decide if and when to ask. In an emergency, call 911.

lines.name: Wellness check (outside Boston)
lines.how_to_reach: Call your local police non-emergency number and ask for a wellness check.
lines.what: If you are worried about yourself or someone you love, the police can stop by to check that you are okay. You decide if and when to ask. In an emergency, call 911.
